File surface (read on `origin/main` `49185cd`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/idp-locale-claim.ts` (new): reads the standard OIDC `locale` claim off the IdP profile better-auth hands the `validateUserInfo` seam (`source.oauth.profile` for generic-OAuth / social providers, the cloud IdP included; `source.sso.profile` for `@better-auth/sso` OIDC providers), closes it against the i18n service's reported locales, and decides the `sys_user.locale` write: set on first creation; on a later sign-in, follow the claim only while the stored value is still the one the IdP last wrote (a local choice wins); an unknown or unsupported claim leaves the column unset, so the deployment default applies.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`: three call sites only: stage the claim in `validateUserInfo`, settle it in the composed `session.create.after` (the one seam every successful IdP sign-in reaches, new user or returning), and clear the IdP record in the composed `user.delete.after`.
- The "what the IdP last wrote" record is a `sys_verification` row per user, written through better-auth's database adapter (the implicit-linking unlink record's idiom in the same package): no schema change, no new column.
- Tests: `idp-locale-claim.test.ts` (pure decision + an end-to-end OAuth round trip over the in-memory engine, the implicit-account-linking harness shape).
- One `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (`Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`).
- ⛔ Not `packages/spec`, `packages/platform-objects` (no column or rule change), `service-messaging`, or the objectui console (it already reads `sys_user.locale` as the signed-in user's language).
Container & model: `M`, card thread (in-session executor), `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` on this surface: "no path-derived mandate"), `effort: high`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Basis for the Clause-② line: no published accept set or public surface changes; a JIT sign-in now fills a column a user could already set for themselves, and nothing a caller could do before is refused.
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- The #25224 move-only split of `auth-manager.ts` is in flight (cut 1 landed as PR #25273); this card adds three call sites there and keeps its logic in a new file, so whichever lands second merges `main`.
- PR #25286 (#25271) touches `last-admin-guard.ts` only; not on this surface.
